svg.title: Marking path: visit order and reversible direction
svg.desc: Fourteen red marking segments on an illustrative nested sheet. Dashed navy arrows connect the origin to each entry, each exit to the next entry, and the final exit to the origin. White numbered discs identify marking operations. The route is manually selected and is not an optimization result.

g.text: Fixed layout. Variable visit order and processing direction.
The selected endpoint is the entry;
its paired endpoint is the exit.
Each column is one visit: operation ID above, direction bit below.
Synthetic schematic · Manually selected route · No collision constraints
